title: Emperor Wu of Han (Liu Che)
kingdom: Han Dynasty (The Golden Age of China)
biography: Regarded as one of China's greatest emperors; he established state Confucianism, doubled the empire's territory, and dispatched explorer Zhang Qian westward, inaugurating the ancient Silk Road.
internationalConnections: Opened direct trade corridors with the Greco-Bactrian kingdoms, Fergana (Heavenly Horses), and Parthia.
